Issue context:
### Summary Background: to make some automation work I need to wrap ansible's ssh usage in a little script. You'll just have to trust me that this script doesn't do anything exciting; it just tweaks some arguments and environment variables and then does an `execve()` of the real ssh. So in ansible.cfg I force it to use my wrapped ssh like so: ``` [ssh_connection] ssh_executable = ../bin/ansible_ssh.py scp_extra_args = "-S ../bin/ansible_ssh.py" sftp_extra_args = "-S ../bin/ansible_ssh.py" ``` Th
